answer: Locks are recorded in ocean, expire in glacier, and raven lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 87 aliases therefore needs 61 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1614 identities would post 1206 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
